clusters.name: Edge & Identity
clusters.description: The Go API gateway that terminates every client request, strips spoofable identity headers, validates JWTs and reverse-proxies to backends, plus the Spring Boot auth-service that issues and refreshes those tokens.

nodes.name: Gateway reverse-proxy router
nodes.description: chi router mapping /api/v1/* and /socket.io prefixes to backend service URLs via httputil.ReverseProxy; strips client-supplied X-User-ID/X-User-Email headers and injects trusted JWT claims before proxying.

nodes.name: Gateway JWT & request middleware
nodes.description: Middleware chain that validates bearer JWTs from the Authorization header, plus CORS, request-id, structured logging and per-IP token-bucket rate limiting.

nodes.name: Gateway circuit breakers & health
nodes.description: Per-route circuit breakers that short-circuit failing backends with 503s, Prometheus metrics middleware and the gateway health endpoint.

nodes.name: Auth & account REST API
nodes.description: Spring controllers and services for register/login/refresh/logout, profile, password change, user lookup and per-user settings (served at /api/v1/auth and /api/v1/settings).

nodes.name: Auth token issuance & Spring Security
nodes.description: JWT signing/validation (JwtTokenProvider, JwtConfig), the request auth filter and the Spring Security filter chain / password encoding configuration.

nodes.name: Auth users, roles & refresh tokens store
nodes.description: JPA entities and repositories for users, roles, refresh tokens and user settings, with Flyway migrations against the shared PostgreSQL database.

clusters.name: Documents
clusters.description: The FastAPI document-service: rich-text documents, comments, templates, share links and exports, persisted in PostgreSQL and announced on the SNS event bus.

nodes.name: Document, comment & template API
nodes.description: FastAPI routers for /api/v1/documents, comments and /api/v1/templates, including the Redis-backed chaos latency hook and health checks.

nodes.name: Document domain services
nodes.description: Business logic for document CRUD, versioning and queries, signed share links and archive/export generation.

nodes.name: Document models & migrations
nodes.description: SQLAlchemy async models and session management, settings, and Alembic migrations for the documents schema in PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: Document event publisher
nodes.description: Publishes document.created/updated/deleted events to the otterworks-events SNS topic for search indexing, notifications and audit.

clusters.name: Files & Storage
clusters.description: The Rust (actix-web) file-service handling uploads, downloads, folders, versions and sharing, with blobs in S3 and metadata in DynamoDB.

nodes.name: File & folder HTTP handlers
nodes.description: actix-web routes for /api/v1/files and /api/v1/folders: upload, ranged download, rename, move, trash, share and version operations, plus request-id middleware, Redis chaos checks and error mapping.

nodes.name: S3 blob storage layer
nodes.description: aws-sdk-s3 wrapper for object put/get/delete and presigned download URLs; service configuration for buckets, endpoints and failure toggles.

nodes.name: DynamoDB file metadata
nodes.description: DynamoDB access for file metadata, folders, versions and shares, plus demo seed data loading.

nodes.name: File events & upload-failure alerts
nodes.description: Publishes file lifecycle events to SNS and fires Grafana-shaped alerts to admin-service's /api/v1/admin/alerts/ingest on failed uploads.

clusters.name: Real-time Collaboration
clusters.description: The TypeScript Socket.IO collab-service providing CRDT document sync and presence for the editor, with state shared through Redis.

nodes.name: Socket.IO collaboration server
nodes.description: Express + Socket.IO server handling document join/sync/update and presence events, metrics and the /api/v1/collab REST surface.

nodes.name: Collab socket authentication
nodes.description: jsonwebtoken-based socket handshake auth middleware and service configuration (JWT secret, Redis, TTLs).

nodes.name: Collab document state & awareness
nodes.description: Redis adapter, versioned document-state store and awareness (cursor/presence) tracking shared across collab replicas.

clusters.name: Search
clusters.description: The FastAPI search-service fronting Meilisearch: full-text search and suggestions over documents and files, kept fresh by SQS-driven indexing.

nodes.name: Search & suggest API
nodes.description: FastAPI routes for /api/v1/search queries, suggestions and index admin, with auth middleware and Redis chaos hooks.

nodes.name: Meilisearch indexer
nodes.description: Meilisearch client and indexer that (re)builds indexes, pulling source records from document-service and file-service.

nodes.name: Search indexing SQS consumer
nodes.description: Background consumer of the otterworks-search-events queue that applies document/file events to the search index.

clusters.name: Reporting, Analytics & Audit
clusters.description: Scala analytics (usage events, rollups, market margins), the Java report-service that renders PDF/CSV/Excel reports, and the .NET audit-service compliance trail.

nodes.name: Analytics HTTP routes
nodes.description: Akka HTTP routes for analytics dashboards, event ingest, market ingest and margin queries under /api/v1/analytics.

nodes.name: Analytics metrics & margin engine
nodes.description: Event processing, metrics aggregation and margin computation over in-memory or PostgreSQL repositories.

nodes.name: Usage rollup & market seed batch
nodes.description: Batch jobs that load events, seed market series and compute usage rollups into PostgreSQL / the S3 data lake.

nodes.name: Report REST API & security config
nodes.description: Spring Boot controllers for /api/v1/reports, Spring Security and Swagger configuration and application properties.

nodes.name: Report rendering pipeline
nodes.description: Async report worker and PDF/CSV/Excel generators with header rendering and date utilities; reports persisted via JPA.

nodes.name: Report cross-service data fetcher
nodes.description: Legacy RestTemplate client that pulls analytics events, audit events and user activity from sibling services to feed reports.

nodes.name: Audit & compliance API
nodes.description: ASP.NET Core controller for /api/v1/audit event query, resource history, user activity, compliance reports and exports, with error/request-logging middleware.

nodes.name: Audit event store & archiver
nodes.description: Audit service core writing events to DynamoDB and archiving aged events to the S3 audit-archive bucket.

clusters.name: Admin, Ops & Incident Triage
clusters.description: The Rails admin-service (users, flags, quotas, chaos, health) and its alert-to-incident pipeline that opens Slack alerts and Devin remediation sessions, plus the observability stack feeding it.

nodes.name: Admin REST API surface
nodes.description: Rails routes and API controllers under /api/v1/admin, CORS and Rack::Attack throttling, secrets and database configuration.

nodes.name: Admin JWT authentication
nodes.description: Rack middleware that verifies admin JWTs and role claims, the AdminUser model and sensitive-parameter log filtering.

nodes.name: Alert ingest, incidents & Devin triage
nodes.description: Grafana-style alert ingest that dedups into incidents, routes Slack notifications and spawns Devin sessions via the Devin API to remediate them.

nodes.name: Chaos flags & probes
nodes.description: Admin endpoints that set/clear Redis chaos flags and probe backend failure paths, together with the scenario catalog and injection script used per tenant.

nodes.name: Service health & metrics aggregation
nodes.description: Polls every backend's /health endpoint and aggregates system metrics for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: Users, flags, quotas & announcements
nodes.description: Admin management of users, feature flags, storage quotas, system config, announcements, bulk operations and admin audit logs, backed by PostgreSQL tables.

nodes.name: Observability & alert rules
nodes.description: Prometheus scrape/alert/recording rules, Grafana dashboards and alerting contact points, OTel/Jaeger tracing, Fluent Bit logging and on-call runbooks.

clusters.name: Billing & Legacy Estates
clusters.description: The modern FastAPI billing-service, the database-centric legacy billing stack with stored procedures and its parity harness, and other legacy estates (Java legacy-portal, Oracle insurance fixture, cron ETL).

nodes.name: Billing plans & entitlement API
nodes.description: FastAPI endpoints for plan catalog, tenant entitlement and plan change (proxied to the web app as /billing-api).

nodes.name: Billing domain & repository
nodes.description: Plan/entitlement domain rules and the psycopg PostgreSQL repository with SQL migrations and seed.

nodes.name: Legacy billing Flask app
nodes.description: Thin Flask UI/API over the legacy billing database that calls stored procedures for plans, rating, invoicing and dunning.

nodes.name: Legacy billing stored procedures
nodes.description: PL/pgSQL schema and stored procedures holding legacy billing business logic (plans, rating, invoicing, dunning).

nodes.name: Stored-procedure parity harness
nodes.description: Record/replay harness with scenarios, transcripts and a rules gate proving extracted billing logic matches stored-procedure behaviour.

nodes.name: Legacy portal controllers & config
nodes.description: Spring Boot legacy portal exposing announcements, feedback and user-preference controllers, with branding settings and on-prem deployment scripts.

nodes.name: Legacy portal services & repositories
nodes.description: JPA entities, repositories and services behind the portal's announcements, feedback and preferences, with its init SQL.

nodes.name: Insurance commission Oracle estate
nodes.description: Oracle Database Free fixture with OLTP commission-pay PL/SQL and an OLAP star schema + ETL package, modelling a legacy database-centric estate.

nodes.name: Legacy cron ETL jobs
nodes.description: Cron-driven Python scripts for analytics rollups, audit archiving, search reindexing, storage cleanup and user activity.

clusters.name: Eventing & Notifications
clusters.description: The SNS/SQS event bus and shared event contracts, the Kotlin notification-service (SQS consumer, email, WebSocket push, preferences) and event-driven consumers such as audit ingestion.

nodes.name: SNS/SQS event bus
nodes.description: otterworks-events SNS topic fanning out to notification, analytics and search-indexing SQS queues (Terraform), mirrored locally in LocalStack.

nodes.name: Shared event & API contracts
nodes.description: JSON Schemas for file, document, collaboration, notification and audit events and OpenAPI specs for document, notification and search services.

nodes.name: Notification REST & WebSocket API
nodes.description: Ktor routes for /api/v1/notifications and /api/v1/preferences, WebSocket push manager, monitoring plugin and configuration.

nodes.name: Notification SQS pipeline & delivery
nodes.description: SQS consumer that turns events into notifications, renders templates, sends email and persists notifications/preferences in DynamoDB.

nodes.name: Notification failure alert publisher
nodes.description: Publishes Grafana-shaped alerts to admin-service when notification processing fails, deduplicated per service.

nodes.name: Audit event SNS consumer
nodes.description: Background consumer that ingests platform events from the event bus into the audit trail.

clusters.name: Frontends & Clients
clusters.description: The React/Vite client app (with Electron and Capacitor shells), the Angular admin dashboard and a WPF Windows desktop client, all talking to the gateway.

nodes.name: Client app shell, auth & API client
nodes.description: React app bootstrap, routing, auth provider/store, the gateway API client and nginx/Vite proxy configuration.

nodes.name: Client files, documents & editor UI
nodes.description: Pages and components for files, folders, sharing, documents, the collaborative editor, search, notifications, settings and margins.

nodes.name: Client billing feature
nodes.description: Plans, change-plan and entitlement pages calling billing-service through the /billing-api proxy.

nodes.name: Electron & Capacitor shells
nodes.description: Electron desktop wrapper with a local server and Capacitor Android/iOS projects packaging the client app.

nodes.name: Admin dashboard core & auth
nodes.description: Angular routes, auth guard, JWT interceptor and the admin API/auth services, with nginx and dev-proxy config.

nodes.name: Admin dashboard pages
nodes.description: Angular pages for dashboard, users, features, quotas, announcements, audit, analytics, health and incidents.

nodes.name: WPF Windows desktop client
nodes.description: WPF/MVVM desktop client using an HTTP API client against the gateway's /api/v1.

clusters.name: Platform, Infra & CI
clusters.description: Local compose stack, Helm charts and Terraform for EKS/AWS, the shared data stores, the ephemeral-tenant lifecycle and ops control plane, and the CI/CD pipelines that build and ship it.

nodes.name: Local docker-compose stack
nodes.description: Compose definitions for all services and local infra (Postgres, Redis, LocalStack, Meilisearch, observability) plus Makefile entry points.

nodes.name: Helm charts & namespace guardrails
nodes.description: Per-service Helm charts (deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets) and namespace ResourceQuota/LimitRange manifests.

nodes.name: Application AWS Terraform
nodes.description: Terraform root and modules for Cognito, IRSA roles and CloudWatch monitoring wiring the application's AWS dependencies.

nodes.name: Cluster Terraform (EKS/VPC/ECR)
nodes.description: Terraform for the shared VPC, EKS cluster/node groups and ECR registry.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL (RDS)
nodes.description: Shared PostgreSQL / RDS instance (per-tenant databases) used by auth, document, admin, analytics, report and billing services.

nodes.name: DynamoDB tables
nodes.description: DynamoDB tables for file metadata, folders, versions, shares, audit events and notifications.

nodes.name: S3 buckets
nodes.description: S3 buckets for user files, the analytics data lake and the audit archive, with LocalStack bootstrap/restore scripts.

nodes.name: Redis (ElastiCache)
nodes.description: Redis used for collab state, gateway/admin chaos flags and caching; ElastiCache in AWS, per-tenant Redis in-cluster.

nodes.name: Meilisearch engine
nodes.description: Meilisearch full-text engine (ECS task + master key secret in AWS, per-tenant in-cluster).

nodes.name: Ephemeral tenant lifecycle scripts
nodes.description: Scripts that deploy, scale, inject and tear down namespace-per-tenant OtterWorks stacks and the dev cluster.

nodes.name: Demo-platform ops dashboard & reaper
nodes.description: Next.js ops dashboard for tenant check-out, the runner image, TTL reaper/idle-suspend/infra-sweep and its IAM/DynamoDB control-table Terraform.

nodes.name: CI/CD pipelines
nodes.description: GitHub Actions for change-detected CI, Docker build & push, tenant CD deploys and the main to demo-coggtm mirror.

nodes.name: API flow tests & seed data
nodes.description: Black-box API flow and contract tests against the gateway, synthetic seed generators/validators and the demo seed script.

clusters.name: Security Harnesses
clusters.description: DAST probing, functional-equivalence and dependency-CVE harnesses with their CI gates, static scanning configuration and Kubernetes network policies.

nodes.name: DAST probe harness
nodes.description: Route inventory, attack-surface model and probes for access control, injection, perimeter exposure and transport, with ZAP baseline config.

nodes.name: Functional-equivalence harness
nodes.description: Records and grades byte-identical behaviour before/after security refactors for registered findings (OW-SEC-40x) against a seeded document-service.

nodes.name: Dependency CVE blast-radius harness
nodes.description: Advisory + module map checker that computes which JVM modules consume a vulnerable dependency and verifies remediation.

nodes.name: SAST, secrets & image scanning config
nodes.description: Trivy, gitleaks and SonarCloud configuration plus the security-scan and SAST auto-remediation workflows.

nodes.name: Security CI gates
nodes.description: GitHub Actions gates that run the DAST scan, equivalence check, dependency remediation check and stored-procedure parity.

nodes.name: Kubernetes network policies
nodes.description: Default-deny, DNS and namespace-egress NetworkPolicies isolating tenant namespaces.
